style: Photorealistic macro tabletop still life on a warm off-white paper surface, soft diffuse morning window light from the left, gentle soft shadows, shallow depth of field, minimal composition with generous empty space, restrained palette of ink black, deep navy blue and warm cream. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no screens. Calm, precise, quiet. Smooth cinematic camera move, single continuous shot.

shots.cut01_report: On a pale cream meeting table, a hand in a charcoal grey sleeve slowly pushes a thin stack of white printed paper sheets (only faint abstract grey bar shapes, no readable text) back across the table toward the camera, then withdraws out of frame. The person's face stays out of frame. Camera at table level slowly pushes in on the returned papers. Large empty cream area in the upper left of the frame.
shots.cut02_marbles: Hundreds of glossy black glass marbles arranged in a perfect dense grid on cream paper, filling the frame, seen from a high angle. Exactly one marble in the grid is clear transparent glass, an empty-looking gap among the black ones. The camera slowly dollies in and descends toward the single clear marble, rack focus so the clear marble becomes sharp while the surrounding black marbles soften into blur. The clear marble stays clear until the end.
shots.cut03_sorter: Side view of a deep navy blue board standing upright on cream paper with one precise square slot cut in it. Identical matte black wooden cubes slide along the table one after another and pass cleanly through the square slot to the other side. Then a wooden ball, a triangular prism and an irregular grey pebble arrive, bump against the slot, cannot pass, and stay outside in front of the board. Slow lateral tracking shot from the slot toward the pieces left outside.
shots.cut04_needle: Extreme close-up of a minimalist analog gauge with a blank cream dial that has only thin plain tick marks, absolutely no numerals and no lettering, with a deep navy blue bezel. A thin black needle wavers slowly back and forth between the tick marks and never settles on any of them. Slow push-in, shallow depth of field, the dial slightly off-center to the right with empty cream space on the left.
shots.cut05_gap: Top-down view of a long white paper measuring strip with plain evenly spaced tick marks and no numbers, lying horizontally across a cream table. From the bottom edge a hand places a small round black marker on one tick mark. From the top edge another person's hand places a small round navy blue marker a few tick marks to the right. Both hands withdraw. The camera slowly pushes in on the gap between the two markers, where a short strip of translucent red tape lies along the strip, softly glowing. Nothing else is red.
shots.cut06_line: Close-up of a hand holding a navy blue ink pen drawing one straight horizontal line along a steel ruler on cream paper, moving left to right toward a small hand-drawn empty circle near the right side. The pen stops clearly short of the circle, leaving a visible blank gap between the end of the line and the circle, then lifts away. Slow lateral tracking following the pen tip, ending on the gap.
shots.cut07_together: Two people's hands reach in from opposite sides of a cream table and together press down one short strip of deep navy blue paper tape horizontally in the center of a large blank sheet of cream paper, smooth it flat with their fingertips, then both withdraw out of frame. The short blue line remains alone in the center in warm morning light. Faces stay out of frame. Slow gentle dolly out from above at a slight angle.
shots.cut04_needle_b: Extreme close-up, straight-on front view, of a minimalist analog gauge with a completely blank cream dial: only a few thin plain tick marks along the top arc, absolutely no numerals and no lettering, deep navy blue bezel. One thin black needle swings widely left and right across the dial like an indecisive pendulum, with large clearly visible motion, overshooting, slowing, reversing, and it keeps swinging until the end without ever settling on a tick mark. Slow gentle push-in. The gauge sits right of center with empty cream space on the left.
shots.cut05_gap_b: Top-down view of a long, completely blank white paper strip with no markings at all lying horizontally across a cream table. From the bottom edge a hand places a small round matte black disc on the strip left of center. From the top edge another person's hand places a small round navy blue disc on the strip a short distance to the right of the black one. Both hands withdraw out of frame. Then the short stretch of the strip between the two discs turns into softly glowing translucent red, and the camera slowly pushes in on that red gap. Nothing else in the frame is red.
